author: "Erasmo Vassallo"

This site is the online, expanded edition of the book *Statistica Economica con R* (2018). Every example is given in three languages, **R**, **Python** and **SAS**, in side-by-side tabs: pick a language once and the choice is kept on every page.

```{=html}
<p><a class="btn btn-primary" href="preface.html">Start with the preface</a>
<a class="btn btn-outline-secondary" href="chapters/01-getting-started.html">Go to Chapter 1</a></p>
```

## Data

All the data files used in the book are in the `data/` folder of the GitHub repository; they can be downloaded one by one or by cloning the whole repository.
